verification.note: invariants.md:7 has a separate clause: on a non-listing shelf page below 640px, the sort menu sits on the header's last row at its right end. The only phone-width I13 test is app-header.spec.ts:195-209. It runs over SHELF_PAGES = ['video-shelf','reading-shelf'] (app-header.measure.ts:22) and asserts `Math.abs(sort.left - m.contentLeft) <= 1` at :206. Its fixture (fixtures/appHeader.tsx:140-154) mounts VideoShelfPage and ReadingShelfPage with by='folder', no entry and no watch. Once params resolve, that gives listing mode: VideoShelfPage.tsx:137 sets `listing = !entryMode && by !== null && query !== null && !watchBlocked`, and ReadingShelfPage.tsx:147 is equivalent. So only the listing branch is measured (VideoShelfPage.tsx:314-328, ReadingShelfPage.tsx:273-288). The non-listing branch (VideoShelfPage.tsx:329-335, ReadingShelfPage.tsx:289) is reachable, for example with by=watch and no profile (watchBlocked). In e2e-components, a grep for a sort-versus-contentRight assertion or 'right end' finds only unrelated SPEC-CORE-098 and 105 tests. The other I13 test (app-header-desktop.spec.ts:63) covers widths of 640px and up. frontend/e2e-layout has no SPEC-CORE-099 reference. The right-end clause below 640px has no test.
